target_customer: Small and mid-size businesses, accountants and bookkeepers who run finances in QuickBooks and spreadsheets
problem: Finance teams exported QuickBooks data and pasted it into spreadsheets each month to build reports. LiveFlow keeps the numbers live in Google Sheets and Excel.
product_category: Finance reporting and FP&A software, later AI-ERP

founders.name: Lasse Kalkar
previous_startups: Crypto micro-investing app (failed, per YC page)

founders.name: Evan O'Brien
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in the TechCrunch seed coverage; TechCrunch 2024 describes him as a former Web Summit engineering lead. Not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Fathom
competitors.what: Australian management reporting and forecasting tool built on accounting data including QuickBooks

technical_complexity.rationale: Reliable two-way sync of accounting data into spreadsheet clients, including consolidation across entities, is standard integration engineering with API quirks.

defensibility.rationale: Reports built in customers' sheets create some lock-in, but QuickBooks connectors for Sheets were easy to build and copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying it; LiveFlow raised a Series A in 2024 and launched an AI-native ERP in February 2026.

market_need_then: Finance teams complained about monthly export and paste workflows; the founders said they felt this frustration in earlier companies. Millions of businesses ran QuickBooks, and the 2021 seed press framed the problem as manual financial data flows.

branding.domain_note: Used liveflow.io for years and now liveflow.com; purchase details not found.

identity.visual_style: Brand identity and web revamp case study exists
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and product focused, with taglines such as 'We go into QuickBooks, so you don't have to'

branding.brand_signature: Live data in your spreadsheet; the 'AI empowers finance. LiveFlow empowers the AI.' tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Site cites 300+ G2 reviews; no memes or merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive compound name that is similar to other Live/Flow brands; trademark filed October 2024; no evidence of the brand driving growth.

outcome_analysis: LiveFlow raised a 3.5M seed in December 2021 from Moonfire, YC, Seedcamp and WndrCo, grew to a claimed 6,000 plus businesses, and raised a 13.5M Series A led by Valar in September 2024. It expanded from spreadsheet sync into FP&A and in February 2026 an AI-native ERP. Still active with a team of 51, it shows steady PMF in a niche but no exit yet.
notes: Seed confirmed by TechCrunch, PYMNTS and Crowdfund Insider; one aggregator gives November 2021 and another a separate 3.8M seed in October 2022, treated as likely errors. Total raised aggregators range 20.8M to 23.2M, unverified. Fathom was identified from the title and date of a LiveFlow blog list (2021-10) and from TechCrunch 2024; I did not open the 2021 post, so traction_then is null. No acquisition, shutdown or layoff news found. Name origin not found.
